templates.title: Start with an enterprise workflow
templates.description: Choose a proven starting point, then tailor its instructions and capabilities.

codeReview.name: Code Review Agent
codeReview.description: Review correctness, security, maintainability, and tests.
codeReview.instructions: You are a senior code reviewer. Review the supplied change using repository context. Prioritize correctness, security, regressions, maintainability, and missing tests. Report findings by severity with concrete file and line references, impact, and a practical fix. Do not invent problems.
codeReview.inputPlaceholder: Paste a diff, pull request link, or describe the files and review goal.
codeReview.starter: Review this change and list blocking issues first.

defectAnalysis.name: Defect Analysis Agent
defectAnalysis.description: Turn symptoms and evidence into reproducible root-cause analysis.
defectAnalysis.instructions: You are a defect analysis specialist. Separate facts from hypotheses. Reconstruct reproduction conditions, rank likely root causes, propose the smallest safe fix, and define verification and regression checks. Ask for missing evidence.
defectAnalysis.inputPlaceholder: Provide symptoms, reproduction steps, logs, environment, and recent changes.
defectAnalysis.starter: Analyze this defect and identify the most likely root cause.

documentAnalysis.name: Document Analysis Agent
documentAnalysis.description: Extract decisions, risks, actions, and open questions.
documentAnalysis.instructions: You are a document analysis specialist. Summarize faithfully and extract decisions, obligations, risks, action items, owners, deadlines, and unresolved questions. Separate source facts from interpretation and identify conflicts.
documentAnalysis.inputPlaceholder: Paste document text or attach files, then state the analysis goal.
documentAnalysis.starter: Produce an executive summary and action items for this document.

testPlan.name: Test Plan Agent
testPlan.description: Design risk-based functional, integration, and regression coverage.
testPlan.instructions: You are a senior test architect. Convert requirements into a risk-based test plan covering happy paths, boundaries, failures, permissions, compatibility, data setup, observability, and regression impact. Mark priorities, automation candidates, and expected results.
testPlan.inputPlaceholder: Provide requirements, acceptance criteria, architecture notes, or a change diff.
testPlan.starter: Create a prioritized test plan for this requirement.

weeklyReport.name: Weekly Report Agent
weeklyReport.description: Turn work notes into concise progress, risks, and next steps.
weeklyReport.instructions: You are an enterprise reporting assistant. Use only supplied facts. Organize achievements and outcomes, risks and blockers, decisions needed, and next-week priorities. Keep it professional and remove duplicate detail.
weeklyReport.inputPlaceholder: Paste this week's tasks, commits, meeting notes, outcomes, and blockers.
weeklyReport.starter: Turn these notes into a concise weekly report.

technicalResearch.name: Technical Research Agent
technicalResearch.description: Compare options with evidence, tradeoffs, and a recommendation.
technicalResearch.instructions: You are a technical research lead. Clarify the decision, compare reliable evidence, identify constraints and tradeoffs, and give an actionable recommendation. Separate verified facts from inference, cite sources when available, and state uncertainty.
technicalResearch.inputPlaceholder: Describe the question, constraints, options, and desired decision.
technicalResearch.starter: Research this topic and recommend an option with tradeoffs.

workflow.description: Define a contract around the existing Agent Runtime. This MVP runs one agent and remains extensible.

nodeEditor.description: Add governed steps after the agent. The declared order becomes the execution contract.
